answer: When a session looks suspicious, the puzzle it faces gets harder: easy for a normal session, steep for an anomalous one. The difficulty adapts to the risk score, so a farm must solve the hardest puzzles on exactly the accounts it most wants to hide, while genuine users rarely see anything beyond a trivial check. A lone hollow cannot fake a session; only the whole pattern counts. The crystal hides nothing and the tundra reveals everything: the audit trail is open to all.
